chunks: "If it is during the Dhuhr prayer, he should make the first two rak'ahs Dhuhr and the last two rak'ahs Asr."

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or transmitted
key_terms.صَلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer being discussed

ai.seo_question: How should the rak'ahs be assigned between Dhuhr and Asr in this narrated ruling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the intention and allocation of rak'ahs between Dhuhr and Asr. It indicates that in a particular prayer circumstance, the first two rak'ahs are counted as Dhuhr and the final two as Asr, showing the precision of fiqh in matters of salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If it is during the Dhuhr prayer, he should make the first two rak'ahs for Dhuhr and the last two rak'ahs for Asr."
